name: MLLM-as-a-Judge
description: MLLM-as-a-Judge is a multimodal benchmark designed to assess the ability of multimodal large language models to assist judges across diverse modalities. It includes three tasks: Scoring Evaluation, Pair Comparison, and Batch Ranking, revealing challenges in judgment capacities such as biases and inconsistencies.
reputation: A new multimodal judging benchmark that has attracted interest for probing judge-like capabilities, but it is not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Highlights persistent challenges in MLLM judgment including biases and hallucinations even in advanced models like GPT-4V.
